mods.name: Voxel 3D
mods.description: Draws the overworld in 3D, built from the cartridge's own tiles. Sky colours follow the clock, water is animated, and you can move the camera. Battles happen on the map you were standing on, while menus stay 2D and pixel-perfect.

mods.name: Randomizer
mods.description: Randomizes a playthrough from a four-digit seed: wild Pokemon, gifts, starters, trades, items, badges, shops, stats, types, movesets and trainer teams. The seed is saved with the game, and the mod checks that key items and badges stay reachable.

mods.name: Follower
mods.description: One of your Pokemon walks behind you, drawn with its own party icon. Pick which one from its party menu, choose whether it stays out on a bike or on water, and put it away with one key. Face it and press A to pet it. It can also pick up hidden items.

mods.name: Overworld Encounters
mods.description: Wild Pokemon walk around on the map instead of appearing during random steps. Up to sixteen per map, taken from that map's own encounter table. Each one leaves after half a minute and another takes its place, so a route keeps rolling new Pokemon while you stand on it. Shinies never leave, and Pokemon with very high DVs glow gold.

mods.name: Hidden Stats
mods.description: Adds a fourth page to a Pokemon's stats screen showing its DVs and the stat experience each stat has trained.

mods.name: Linking Cord
mods.description: An item that evolves trade-only Pokemon without trading. Sold on the second floor of Goldenrod Dept Store.

mods.name: Quality of Life
mods.description: Seven conveniences, each with its own switch and all off by default: field moves without a Pokemon that knows them, Repel renewal, EXP from catches, PC in the start menu, type effectiveness hints, stat stages and a weather indicator.

mods.name: Shiny Charm
mods.description: Complete the Pokedex, get your diploma from the GAME designer in Celadon, and he hands you a Shiny Charm. While it is in your bag, wild Pokemon are three times more likely to be shiny.

mods.name: Catch Combo
mods.description: Catch the same species over and over and the odds of a shiny climb, the way a Catch Combo works in the Let's Go games. The combo counts a catch from anywhere, grass, water, a rod, a tree or a rock, and a box after each one says how long it is now.

mods.name: Achievements
mods.description: Thirty achievements, one for each of the sixteen badges and fourteen more for the things a Johto run is remembered by. A notice says when one is unlocked and a list says which are left. Installing it on a save already played reads what that save has and awards all of it under one line rather than thirty.
